if(s.backgroundImage!=='none'||Number(s.opacity)!==1)manual=true;}const s=getComputedStyle(e),fg=over(rgb(s.color),bg),l=[lum(fg),lum(bg)].sort((a,b)=>b-a),ratio=(l[0]+.05)/(l[1]+.05),target=Number(s.fontSize.replace('px',''))>=24||(Number(s.fontSize.replace('px',''))>=18.666&&Number(s.fontWeight)>=700)?3:4.5;rows.push({text:text.slice(0,110),selector:e.tagName.toLowerCase()+(e.className?'.'+String(e.className).trim().replaceAll(' ','.'):''),ratio:ratio,target,manual});} const controls=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input,select,button,progress,meter')).filter(e=>e.getClientRects().length&&!e.closest('[hidden]')&&(!e.closest('details:not([open])')||e.closest('summary'))).map(e=>({tag:e.tagName,type:e.getAttribute('type'),name:e.getAttribute('name'),accessibleName:e.getAttribute('aria-label')||Array.from(e.labels||[]).map(l=>l.innerText).join(' ')||e.innerText||'',group:e.closest('fieldset')?.querySelector('legend')?.innerText||''}));return {minimum_sampled_ratio:Math.min(...rows.filter(r=>!r.manual).map(r=>r.ratio)),lang:document.documentElement.lang,title:document.title,h1:document.querySelectorAll('h1').length,contrast_checked:rows.filter(r=>!r.manual).length,contrast_failures:rows.filter(r=>!r.manual&&r.ratio<r.target),manual_background_review_n:rows.filter(r=>r.manual).length,unnamed_controls:controls.filter(c=>!c.accessibleName),control_count:controls.length,radio_groups:controls.filter(c=>c.type==='radio').map(c=>({name:c.name,group:!!c.group}))};
